answer: Make earning power age the way a river cuts marble: slowly. A new identity earns 1% of the full reward, rising 1 point per epoch only if it submits a peer-graded answer that epoch. A farm of 100 fresh puppets earns 100 x 1% = one veteran's share while paying for 100 answers. Weakness: a patient farm can age many identities in parallel. Mitigation: a missed or 0-graded epoch resets the ramp, so each puppet needs real, original work for 100 straight epochs; idle ferrous shells just rust back to zero.
